purpose: Authenticate the completed M2 sweep, compute declared analyses and export DR1–DR12 without new simulations or fitting.

environment.python: 3.13.14 used for reported execution; package supports Python>=3.11
environment.runner_prefix: uv run --group model --group notebook --with scikit-learn==1.9.1 python

inputs.bundle: Externally supplied immutable design.json, rows.json, labels.csv and draws.parquet.
inputs.raw: Original completed trajectory Parquets and receipt.json. Do not mix designs.
inputs.bindings_json: bundle_sha256 maps all four filenames to SHA256. Also supply code_commit, pin_sha256 and receipt_sha256 externally.
inputs.protected_observations: No observed data on/after2025-11-19T16:00:00Z is fitted, selected or scored by this workflow.

commands.association_join: Concatenate the eight mm1__<family>__<horizon>.csv files with one header and unchanged columns. Record the resulting SHA256. Pooled-yield rows use yield_pp=pooled.

interpretation.uncertainty: 1000 shared whole-unit bootstrap draws, seed20261005,95% percentile intervals. Conditional design summaries, not demonstrated empirical predictive coverage.
interpretation.CART_margin: Lower95bound of paired OOF correctness minus training-fold-majority correctness. Regression has MSE/R2 and no prescribed Informative verdict.
interpretation.PRIM: Choose bounds on A only, confirm unchanged on B once. Both B coverage/density>=.7. Not found remains a result.
interpretation.tiers: A-only sampled point or fixed A-selected box, B pass share and separate issuance-mean interval. Zero cost is diagnostic. All ranges provisional until fresh-seed reruns.
interpretation.BH: Full 1000-draw inclusive-tail percentile inversion with conservative add-one, matrix BH5%. Undefined slots retain missing p/q/star with p=1 multiplicity bookkeeping only. No empirical QMC FDR claim.
interpretation.noise: Balanced nonnegative one-way random-effects variance fraction. Preserve raw between-component estimate and bootstrap all8keys together within each of64points.
interpretation.Sobol: All compatible Saltelli blocks; responses are inputs. Constant outcomes undefined. Negative/above-one indices retained.256/512maxmovement>.02 means not converged.
interpretation.MM7: Owner-supplied timed evaluation remains separate. Runtime is not contract2.8 acceptance.
interpretation.precision: Float64 final KPIs, not exact integer daily-state replay. The producer receipt contains no independent conservation proof.

storage: Keep raw trajectories, cache tables, full task results and report HTML/CSV outside Git. Commit only implementation, tests, protocol and compact hash-bound evidence.
review: Run tests, lint, client boundary check and intended-source clean checkout checks. Independently validate selected statistics and every final artifact hash/schema. Inspect exported PNGs and exercise HTML scope switching.
